title: Write a Scientific Report

requirements.devices: One web-capable device per group or student
requirements.software: Modern browser and Google Docs for the normal group-writing workflow
requirements.account: A school Google account is required only for Google Docs
requirements.internet: Required to open and collaborate in Google Docs; the module can be revisited offline after its assets have loaded
requirements.storage: Module progress, the group Doc link, and the reference list are stored only in the current browser and device
requirements.offlineFallback: Print the module guide and report outline, then write in a local document or on paper until Google Docs is available

privacy.studentAccounts: The public module does not request a student account
privacy.writingLab: Text pasted into the Writing Lab is processed in the browser and is not saved
privacy.personalData: Only an optional group name, Google Doc link, and source metadata entered in the reference maker are stored locally

sources: Feria Científica Nacional del Ingenio Juvenil 2026: Estructura del informe escrito
